sloka: ध्वजाग्रे धनुषश्चाग्रे किरीटाग्रे च तं हरिम् ।लक्ष्मणो ऽथ हनूमांश्च दृष्ट्वा रामश्च विस्मिताः ।। ६.५९.८१ ।।।।
transliteration: dhvajāgre dhanuṣaścāgre kirīṭāgre ca taṁ harim ।lakṣmaṇo 'tha hanūmāṁśca dṛṣṭvā rāmaśca vismitāḥ ।। 6.59.81 ।।।।

translations.english: Neela stood on top of the post of the bow of Ravana. On seeing that Ravana was burning in anger while Neela roared.
